title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
March 31, 2025
Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543-0001
 Re: Chiles v. Salazar
  Case No. 24-539
Dear Hon. Harris,
Certiorari was granted in the above-captioned matter on March 10, 2025.
Pursuant to Rule 25.3 Petitioner’s brief on the merits and joint appendix
must be filed within 45 days of that order (April 24) and Respondent’s brief filed
within 30 days thereafter (May 27).
In accordance with Rule 30.4, the parties jointly request an extension of these
deadlines as follows:
Petitioner’s Brief:  June 6, 2025
Joint Appendix:  June 6, 2025
Respondent’s Brief:  August 19, 2025
Reply brief:   September 18, 2025
Thank you for your consideration of this extension request.
Respectfully Submitted,
s/John J. Bursch
John J. Bursch
Counsel for Petitioner
s/Shannon Wells Stevenson
   Shannon Wells Stevenson
   Counsel for Respondent
